about.description: Colonnades is a beachfront condo complex in Gulf Shores operated by Brett/Robinson Vacation Rentals, a family-owned company with over 40 years of experience in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. The property offers beautiful white sand beach access with modern amenities and accommodations for families and groups.
